content: Owasârhaze owâbo
Anacibwîra abaganda bâge, erhi: «Kurhankahashikana harhabè okusârhaza, ci kwônene buhanya bwâge owâkulerhe!»
Kwankamukwânana kulusha ashwêkerwe ibuye ly’olwanjikwa omu igosi anakwêbwe omu nyanja, ahâli h’okusârhaza muguma muli abà bâna barhò.
Mucîlange! Okurhabâla ohabire n’okubabalira orhutumuzize (Mat 18, 15.21-22) «Erhi owinyu ankajira kubî, omukalihire, n’akacîgaya, omubabalire».
«Ciru ankakubîhira kali nda omu lusiku luguma na kali nda akuyishire, erhi: “Ncîgayire”, “onamubabalire”».
Obuyêmêre buhasha byoshi
Entumwa zabwîra Nyakasane, mpu: «Orhuyûshûlire obuyêmêre».
Nyakasane ashuza, erhi: «Mucigwârhaga obuyêmêre bungana emogomogo y’e­mburho y’esinapi, mwânabwîra ogu murhi, mpu: “Kunduka, oj’imera mula nyanja”, gwanammuyumva».
Okurhumikira abirhu n’obwirhobye
«Ndi muli mwe ojira omwambali ohinga nîsi erhi oyâbula ebintu, wa­nkamubwîra afuluka, erhi: “Kanya duba oj’irya?”
“Abule okumubwîra erhi­ kwo, erhi”: “Onteganyize ebiryo, ohwinje bwinjà, ontumikire
kuhika nyûs’irya nanyûs’inywa; nâwe ogal’iyish’irya onanywe?”»
Ewe! K’anavuga oyo mwa­mbali omunkwa bulya ajizire nka oku ali arhegesirwe?
Ninyu kwo n’okwo; nka mwamayûs’ijira ebi murhegesirwe, muderhe, mpu: «Rhuli barhumisi ba busha; ntâco rhwajizire cirhàli cirhegeke».
Yezu afumya bashomyo ikumi
Kwanacibà, erhi akola ali omu njira y’okujà e Yeruzalemu, agera elubibi lw’e Samâriya n’olw’e Galileya.
Erhi ajà omu cishagala ciguma, bantu ikumi balwâla olushomyo bamujayo. Bayimanga kulî.
Banaciyakûza, mpu: «Mâshi Yezu Mwigiriza, orhufè nîrhu bwonjo»
Erhi ababona, ababwîra, erhi: «Mugendag’icîyêrekana emwa abadâhwa». Erhi bakola bali omu njira mpu bayije, banacifuma.
Muguma muli bo, erhi abona oku afumire, agaluka, aj’akuza Nnâmahanga n’izù linene.
Acîrhimba aha magulu ga Yezu, amuvuga omunkwa. Oyo muntu àli Musamâriya.
Obwo Yezu anaciderha, erhi: «K’arhali oku banali ikumi boshi bafumire? Balya bandi mwenda ngahi?
Ntà wundi wagalusire mpu ahè Nyamuzinda irenge ecirhali eci cigolo conene!»
Okubundi amubwîra, erhi: «Yimanga, ocîgendere; obwêmêre bwâwe bwa­ kucizize».
Obwâmi bwa Nnâmahanga bwayishire
Abafarizeyi bamudôsa mpu mangaci Obwâmi bwa Nyamuzinda bwâyishe. Anacibashuza, erhi: «Obwâmi bwa Nyamuzinda burhamanywa amango buyisha,
na ntâye wankaderha mpu: bwo buno nîsi erhi bwo bulà! Bulya O­bwâmi bwa Nyamuzinda buli ekarhî kinyu».
Olusiku lwa Mwene-omuntu
Anacibwîra abaganda bâge, erhi: «Ensiku zaciyisha, mucîfinje okubona lusiku luguma lwa Mwene-omuntu
, murhanalubone.
“Bayish’ikammubwîra, mpu”: “Y’oyo oli hano! nîsi, mpu”: “Y’oyo oli hala! Murhayijaga murhanayilibirhiraga”.
“Bulya nka kulya omulazo gumoleka omu bitù kurhenga Ebushoshôkero kuhika Ebuzikiro, ntyo kwo Mwene omuntu ayish’iyisha Olusiku lwâge”.
“Kwônene burhanzi kukânîne ababale kunene n’okulahirwa n’eri iburha”.
“Nka kulya byàbaga omu mango ga Nûhu, kwo byanayish’ibà omu nsiku za Mwene-omuntu”.
“Bakâg’ilya banakanywa, bakasheba banakashebwa, kuhika lulya lusiku Nûhu ajaga omu nkugè; ecihonzi càyisha, càbaho­mbya boshi”.
“Na nka kulya byàbaga omu mango ga Loti, bakalya banakanya, banagula banakaguza, bakabiba banakayûbaka”.
“Ci olusiku Loti arhengaga e Sodomo, enkuba y’omuliro n’ey’ecibiriti yania, yabasingônola boshi.”
“Ntyo kwo byayish’ibà Olusiku Mwene-omuntu anaciyêrekane”.
“Muli olwo Lusiku, omuntu wâbè oku burhungiri bw’enyumpa, akabà ebirugu byâge biri omu nyumpa, arhayandagalaga mpu abirhôle; n’owâbè ali omu ishwa, kwo na kuguma, arhashubiraga nyuma”.
“Mukengêre olwa mukà-Loti
“Owâlonze okuciza obuzîne bwâge, anâbuheze, n’owâbuheze, anâbulamye”.
“Ka mmubwîre: muli obwo budufu, bantu babiri bâbè bali haguma aha ncingo nguma, muguma ahêkwe n’owâbo alekwe”;
“bakazi babiri bâbè badwîrhe bashwera haguma, muguma ahêkwe n’owâbo alekwe”; [
“bantu babiri banâbè bali omu ishwa, muguma ahêkwe n’owâbo alekwe]”».
Nabo banacimushuza, mpu: «Ngahi, Waliha?» Ababwîra, erhi: «Ngasi aha omurhumba gwâbè ho n’enyunda zâshubûkire

footnotes.text: 17, 22 Amango amalumwa gabayishira, abaganda ba Yezu bayish’icîfinja okubona Yezu ciru lusiku luguma, mpu abarhulirize, barhanamubone.
17, 37 Kulya enyunda zicigusha ahâli omurhumba, ziyigurhe, ntyo kwo n’abîshogwa bayish’ishubûkira Mwâmi Yezu omu lusiku lw’amasîma garhahwa.
